scope: Read-only desktop identity audit; no Qt window, desktop switch, input injection or cursor movement requested.
finding: Existing CreateDesktopW/CreateProcessW lpDesktop path placed this child on its named private desktop while the input desktop remained Default.
interpretation: Cursor samples differed by one pixel even in this no-UI probe. The samples contain no attribution information; neither user movement nor application interference is established.
change: Correct hidden_desktop module documentation: private desktop assignment is not an unconditional guarantee about arbitrary child code or externally changing foreground/cursor state.
prior_results: Native form/signage/dinner observer mismatches remain unresolved and are not reclassified as passes.
limits: One short read-only child launch does not prove all native application paths are non-interfering.
No continuous input-desktop monitoring; before/after samples cannot exclude transient changes.
No historical foreground PID records exist for earlier probes, so those changes cannot be attributed retrospectively.
Follow-up native probes should record actual child desktop and input-desktop identity before constructing Qt windows; this audit does not add that guard to every prior script.
Only a test-helper docstring changed; no application behavior or function signatures changed.
Full UI/UX, pet events, independent review, integration and hardware acceptance remain incomplete.
